attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (RHEL 7.9) and configured /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf to cap its login sessions at 8192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), soft and hard. Confirmed pam_limits is wired into system-auth/password-auth so the limits apply to login sessions, and verified via `su - appworker` that ulimit -n returns 8192 and ulimit -u returns 256. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a pre-restart boot_id/uptime/account baseline, triggered `shutdown -r now` (acknowledgement returned before disconnect), polled until node1 was reachable again, proved the boot_id changed (151c4aa9... -> d407be00...) and uptime reset to the reboot time, and re-verified the appworker account and its 8192/256 limits still hold post-restart.
